suggested_fix: No fix required. The function checks for a NULL connector, recomputes the mask while holding conn->lock, and records whether the parent has just started watching children. It calls fsnotify_conn_set_children_dentry_flags() only after dropping the spinlock, so it does not walk the children under a spinlock. Stale PARENT_WATCHED flags left behind when watching stops are cleared lazily in __fsnotify_parent(), which avoids the softlockup caused by eagerly walking very large child lists.
